name: ROS 2 Humble (Ubuntu 22.04) - humble branch
install:
sudo apt-get update -qq || true
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confdef -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold gazebo libgazebo-dev ros-humble-gazebo-ros-pkgs ros-humble-ros-gz ros-humble-rviz2 ros-humble-joint-state-publisher || true
rosdep install --from-paths src --ignore-src -r -y --rosdistro humble --skip-keys "small_gicp sophus opencv2 osqp behaviortree_cpp libg2o-dev" || true
